## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

The validation harness: tools that compare the engine with recorded patient data and with the Pulse Physiology Engine,
grade scenario targets, guard against waveform regressions, and build blind-review bundles and the bedside checklist.
Recorded and generated signals are measured with the same code, so a difference belongs to the signal, not the method.
For a clinician-educator or reviewer this is where the model's behaviour is checked — the model is for teaching, and the
bands it misses are in `../validation/known-misses.md`; for an embedding developer it backs `pnpm validate`.
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

- Grading: the error is 0 when a target holds, otherwise the distance to the nearest satisfying value as a percentage
  of its magnitude; green = holds (within 10 % for equal-to and trend targets), yellow = misses by < 30 %, red = misses
  by ≥ 30 % or no measurement; an evidence band replaces the 10 % zone; red fails `pnpm validate`
  (`segments/grade.ts`).
- Morphology: each recorded window is measured twice with the same code, on the recording and on a matched engine run;
  per metric and HR bin the distributions are compared by median, IQR, KS D and Wasserstein-1 and graded against the
  band (`morphology/suite.ts`).
- A matched run copies the window's HR, SBP/DBP, arterial site, ventilator settings and EtCO2, cycles NIBP every minute
  and warms up for 180 s (`engine/match.ts`).
- ECG intervals on a lead-II median beat: 0.5–40 Hz band-pass, baseline = median of the 250–200 ms pre-R segment,
  onsets and offsets by a slope rule, T end by the tangent method (Lepeschkin–Surawicz), QTc Fridericia = QT/RR^(1/3)
  (`metrics/intervals.ts`).
- Per breath, PPV = (PPmax − PPmin)/mean(PPmax, PPmin) × 100 and SPV = SBPmax − SBPmin, the median over breaths with
  ≥ 3 beats (`metrics/resp-variation.ts`; research 03 §2.4); the capnogram angle is α = 180° − atan(s_II/25) +
  atan(s_III/25) (`metrics/capno.ts`).
- Pulse oracle: identical scenarios run in Pulse 4.3.2 and in this engine and the truth values are compared within
  tolerances; known Pulse errors are expected disagreements, asserted to stay on the wrong side so a Pulse fix is
  noticed (`oracle/oracle.ts`; `docs/physiology/pulse-parameter-annex.md` §C–§D).
- Regression baselines: fixed scenarios, 5 s windows per channel compared sample by sample with a 2 % limit floored at
  5 % of the window's peak-to-peak (`regression/baseline.ts`; NOTICES N-P02).
- VitalDB windows are a deterministic stratified pick (site × age band × sex × non-sinus pre-operative ECG); a window
  is tagged hypotension after ≥ 60 s of MAP < 65 (`datasets/vitaldb.ts`).
- Blind-review clips are 10 s real and synthetic segments passed through the same 0.5–40 Hz band; the answer key is
  kept beside the bundle, never shown to the rater (`review/clips.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->
